description: List active listings that are eligible for an SB 9 lot split or duplex conversion, with the per-parcel block reasons where they are not. California-only; this is a parcel-level buildability read, not a generic lead list.

excludeBlockers.description: Drop parcels carrying any development blocker.

limit.description: Max rows to return. Clamped to your API key's tier ceiling.

minUnits.description: Only parcels supporting at least this many SB 9 units.

status.description: Filter by SB 9 status. Defaults to any non-blocked parcel.

name: list_sb9_inventory
